build_d2go_model: build a D2Go model from a CfgNode config with modeling hooks and FSDP support
build_meta_arch: build the model architecture from cfg.MODEL.META_ARCHITECTURE and cast it to the target device
create_D2GoModelBuildResult: create a D2GoModelBuildResult dataclass to store a built model and its applied modeling hooks
review_build_d2go_model: review the build_d2go_model function to understand FSDP distributed initialization and modeling hook application
refactor_build_meta_arch: refactor build_meta_arch to register a custom meta-architecture in D2Go's META_ARCH_REGISTRY
